label: 🔶 아브르반디 이카트 — 20대 실크공방
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot.
Model: one woman in her twenties, athletic hourglass build, defined waist and shoulders, long dark hair in a single thick braid over one shoulder.
Pose: mid-turn, one foot crossing behind the other, torso twisting toward the camera while the hips stay angled away, one arm lifted holding a hanging silk skein.

Body fully painted with: Uzbek abr-bandi ikat — bold cloud-blurred shapes in crimson, saffron, emerald and white on black. Large flame and pomegranate forms across the torso, ram's-horn hooks down the legs, narrow rainbow warp stripes along the arms. Every edge feathered and bleeding in the characteristic ikat blur. Density high everywhere, colors packed with no black ground left exposed.

Pigment applied directly on bare skin, matte, pores and skin texture visible.
The paint ends at the wrist and ankle in a thin crisp border; hands and feet bare.
Hands fully visible, five separated fingers each.

Barefoot on a woven rug.
Environment: a silk workshop, skeins of dyed thread hanging in rows.
Lighting: hard daylight from a high side window raking down across the twist of the torso, strong shadow in the small of the back, weak fill opposite.
Style: documentary photography of textile craft. ultra-sharp 8K. portrait 2:3 vertical.
